name: Frequency Domain Depth Cueing via Impulse Shifting
definition: A technique to implement depth cueing (fading with distance) in frequency domain volume rendering by manipulating the spectrum of the volume data, avoiding spatial domain convolution.
summary: Frequency Domain Depth Cueing via Impulse Shifting applies distance-based attenuation in the frequency domain by shifting an interpolation filter, avoiding expensive spatial convolution or repeated 3D FFTs.
